answer: The jetty index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 564 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lotus queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 339 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
